Test Method: Anodic Polarization -  Anodic polarization tests performed in deaerated 4 M sodium chloride (NaCl) solution at 80°C. The electrochemical cell for the test consisted of a 1-L multineck flask, as specified in ASTM G 5 with a platinum counter electrode and a saturated calomel electrode (SCE) positioned in a salt bridge with a high-silica tip.
Heat treatment: solution-annealed for 2 h at 1,050°C and then aged at 850°C for 30 min, 1 h, and 10 h.
